faq.title: Photo guide questions.
faq.sub: Quick answers about using these guides to take your own photo.

items.q: Can I take a passport or visa photo at home?
items.a: In many cases, yes, but the rules depend on the country and on how you apply. Check your country's official photo requirements before you shoot.

items.q: What do I need to get started?
items.a: A phone with a camera, a plain wall, a window with daylight, and a helper, a timer or something steady to prop the phone on.

items.q: Do these guides work for both passport and visa photos?
items.a: Yes. The steps work for both, but the size, background colour and file limits can differ by country and application type, so check the rule for your destination.

items.q: What if my country's rules are different?
items.a: Your country's rules win. The guides cover the default rules, which are a good starting point, so always check your country's official requirements before you shoot.

items.q: What do I do after I take the photo?
items.a: Pick the sharpest, evenly lit photo and open it in the editor to crop it to your country's size. Upload the original photo, not a screenshot or a compressed copy.
